text:
alex: Quick kickoff — joint perf/W + kernel-tuning run with NovaSI. Need to lock lab window + agree telemetry + kernel patch flow. Who's available next week? cc @maria @troy
maria: I'm available Wed-Fri. Do we run full suite or a trimmed smoke first?
troy: NovaSI asked for a trimmed smoke first: seq len 128/512/1024, batch sizes 1/4/8, and perf/W capture per-node. We'll expand after baseline.
jia: For kernel tuning we need their kernel branch + repro steps. Also want access to node_exporter metrics and PCIe telemetry if available.
kate: I'll reach out to NovaSI PM for branch + creds. @nova_pm can you confirm what telemetry endpoints you can expose?
nova_pm: We can expose node_exporter + nvlink counters and a simple sftp drop for kernel trees. Need an NDA addendum for some telemetry fields — we've sent legal.
bench-bot: telemetry schema suggestion:
```
cpu_power_w
gpu_power_w
board_power_w
node_temp_c
ambient_temp_c
token_throughput
latency_p50
latency_p95
kv_cache_hit_rate
```
sam: Note: record power cap, fan profiles, and BIOS revision in run metadata. Small drift in power cap skews perf/W.
maria: Pass/fail thresholds proposal: throughput regression <= 10% vs baseline, perf/W drop <= 5% after kernel tuning. Any objections?
troy: Sounds good. Also track tail latency p99 and directive about warm KV cache vs cold.
alex: Runbook owners: I'll draft the runbook and scripts (runbook: `runbooks/novasi-perf-watt.md`). Kate: partner comms + legal. Jia: kernel patch validation and bisect harness. Maria: analysis dashboards and thresholds. Sam: lab ops & run gating.
kate: Pinged NovaSI PM for kernel branch + SFTP creds. They'll send by EOD tomorrow.
jia: For kernel patches, can we run `git bisect`+`perf stat` scripts in ci-runner? I can port our harness. Example command:
```
./ci/run_bench.sh --config configs/novasi-smoke.json --collect perfstat
```
maria: We'll need a short pre-run checklist: environment snapshot, powercap, BIOS, kernel commit, NV driver version, pinned model version, dataset shard id.
alex: Agreed. Also create a minimal dashboard in Grafana with perf/W metric and throughput/time-series. I'll template it.
bench-bot: Suggested tags for metrics: `partner=novasi`, `run_id=<uuid>`, `kernel_commit=<sha>`, `power_cap_w=<n>`
troy: Proposed lab window: Wed 09:00 - Fri 18:00 PT next week. Can we reserve 2 test nodes + 1 bench node?
sam: Reserving nodes now. I'll also script automated reboots between runs to flush thermal drift.
kate: Legal confirmed NDA addendum queued. NovaSI PM said they'll get infra creds by EOD.
maria: I'll draft pass/fail checklist and upload to the runbook.
alex: Great. Pre-run sync: Monday 30m with partner to confirm telemetry and cadence. I'll send calendar. Thanks team — will post runbook link here once live. :thumbsup:
